name: paired-bars
title: Paired Bars
description: Grouped horizontal bars for exactly two measurements per subject, sharing one gridded scale and one entity hue.

meta.question: How do two measurements of the same subjects compare?
meta.whenToUse: The same subjects measured two ways (two harnesses, two environments, two setups, plan vs fact) where per-subject deltas matter.
meta.antiUse: More than two measurements per subject — use a table or bench-matrix; two rivals over time — use delta-bars.
